body.condition: For every \(m\) and \(I\in\mathcal I\), the vector with coordinate \(h_j^m\mathbf 1\{j\notin I\}\) at each \(j\in\mathcal J\) belongs to \(\mathcal H_0\).

novel.justification: A confirmatory design can prespecify a finite collection of clinically relevant local alternatives and their coordinatewise null-boundary projections; this makes every intersection-null boundary an explicit stress scenario without restricting recruitment.
